import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform divider rows/columns, excluding the border and 8 markers.
    divrows=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0] != 8]
    divcols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c] != 8]
    rbounds=[-1]+divrows+[h]
    cbounds=[-1]+divcols+[w]
    out=[]
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        row=[]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(rbounds[ri]+1,rbounds[ri+1]) for c in range(cbounds[ci]+1,cbounds[ci+1])]
            n=cells.count(8)
            # all panels share one non-marker fill color
            fill=next((x for x in cells if x != 8),0)
            row.append(1 if n>1 else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

demo=[[5,5,5,0,8,5,5,0,5,8,5],[8,5,5,0,5,5,5,0,5,5,5],[5,5,5,0,5,5,5,0,5,5,5],[0]*11,[5,5,8,0,5,5,5,0,5,5,5],[5,5,5,0,5,5,5,0,5,5,8],[5,5,5,0,8,5,5,0,5,5,5],[0]*11,[5,5,5,0,5,5,5,0,8,5,5],[5,5,5,0,5,5,5,0,5,8,5],[5,5,8,0,5,8,5,0,5,5,5]]
